row:
Elite Healers Sports Massage is an in-person massage therapy clinic and here on YouTube. We are your recovery specialists focusing on athletic recovery and recovery from injury. Recovery is an important aspect to keeping your muscles healthy and are there for you.
Follow along in our new online series featuring New York State Licensed Massage Therapist, Personal Trainer, and former Professor Adam Cardona as he teaches you self massage therapy techniques, stretching, massage, mobility, gait and sports massage in NYC. We bring you new videos as often as possible.
So whether you are a student, a pro-athlete, a professional office worker, looking to improve your posture, or just need to reduce your stiffness then subscribe, follow along, then check out our website to schedule your first appointment.

Visit our website: elitehealerssportsmassage.com
